name: travel-preview
description: A travel is previewed before it is added. Standing keys on 0 and on 60 two metres along -Y (as in travel-two-metres). The preview works out the same travel on a copy: frames 0..60, the auto gait, and the hips' path on every frame from the standing root head (0, -0.0108229, 0.8724132) to (0, -2.0108229, 0.8724132), the travel fading into the keys at both ends. The animation is unchanged: still one layer with its two keys.
